gw_exits.add.text: Add a VPN key: in the web panel — {panel}, in the SSH menu — {menu} ({what}).
gw_exits.detail.leg_booting: leg {iface} is still coming up after the reboot
gw_exits.detail.leg_young: leg {iface} came up {s} s ago, waiting for its first answer
gw_exits.detail.no_root: can’t check through the exit (needs root)
gw_exits.detail.xray_stale: xray hasn’t checked it for a while
gw_exits.detail.xray_young: xray started {s} s ago, waiting for its check
gw_exits.log.boot_up: GW after reboot: AmneziaWG exits are up ({legs})
gw_exits.log.heal_failed: GW legs: gokaskad --egress-awg-heal (code {rc}) didn’t fix the AmneziaWG legs ({what}), still broken: {still}; next try in a minute
gw_exits.log.healed: GW legs: AmneziaWG legs fixed, working ones untouched ({what})
gw_exits.log.ru_ports: GW: the file of the ports of the domestic exits ru-ports.json was not written: {err}
gw_exits.log.xray_refused: GW xray: key #{n} is off — xray doesn’t accept it with its new parameters or without them
gw_exits.log.xray_ext: GW xray: key #{n} checked by xray once it was installed — built with all its parameters
gw_exits.log.xray_legacy: GW xray: key #{n} is built without its new parameters (as in 3.3.5) — xray didn’t accept them
gw_exits.offline: Gateway devices have no internet right now: there are no exits, and “Block” is set for exit failure. Add a VPN key or choose “Go direct”.
gw_exits.parser.missing: No key parser for the pool ({path}): open “Telegram API proxy” in the gokaskad menu.
gw_exits.parser.old: The key parser {path} is outdated (missing {names}): update gokaskad.
gw_exits.preview.no_awg_in_vpn: This vpn:// link has no AmneziaWG (WireGuard, OpenVPN or XRay from the Amnezia app can’t be added this way): export the AmneziaWG configuration or a .conf file in the app.
gw_exits.preview.no_keys: No keys found: paste a VPN key (vless, hy2, ss, trojan, vmess, vpn://) or the text of an AmneziaWG/WireGuard .conf.
gw_exits.preview.subscription: Subscription link: its keys will be known once it’s added.
gw_exits.problem.awg3_lost: AmneziaWG 3.x key saved without its 3.x fields — add it again
gw_exits.problem.awg_bad_addr: the client address in the AmneziaWG key is outside private networks or taken by a network of this server — the key won’t do, ask for a new one
gw_exits.problem.awg_gw_net: the client address {addr} falls within the gateway network of this server {net} — move the gateway of one of the servers to another network (in the panel: Settings › Gateway › Gateway network); the devices of the gateway you move will need new keys
gw_exits.problem.awg_self_ep: the server address in the key points to this server — the key won’t do, ask for a new one
gw_exits.problem.vless_self_ep: the server address in the key points to this server — the key won’t do, ask for a new one
gw_exits.problem.dup: duplicate of the key on the line above — the gateway doesn’t use it
gw_exits.problem.key_bad_link: couldn’t read the {proto} key: the link has no password, address or port, or has something xray can’t do
gw_exits.problem.key_self_ep: the server address in the {proto} key points to this server — the key won’t do, ask for a new one
gw_exits.problem.key_xray_refused: this version of xray doesn’t accept the {proto} key — with its new parameters or without them; the exit is off, the others work. The same link won’t help — ask whoever issued the key for a new link
gw_exits.problem.key_bad_pin: {proto} key: its certificate fingerprint (pcs, pinSHA256) isn’t a SHA-256
gw_exits.problem.key_dup_endpoint: a second {proto} key at the same server address and port — xray would use the settings of the first one; remove the extra key
gw_exits.problem.key_insecure: {proto} key without a certificate check (allowInsecure) and without a certificate fingerprint — xray won’t accept it; add it again to pin the fingerprint, or get a key with a fingerprint (pcs, pinSHA256)
gw_exits.problem.key_insecure_quic: {proto} key without a certificate check (insecure) and without a fingerprint — xray won’t accept it; its fingerprint can’t be pinned (QUIC) — get a key with a fingerprint (pinSHA256)
gw_exits.problem.key_no_tls: {proto} key without TLS to a public address — the password would travel in clear text; a key with TLS is needed
gw_exits.problem.key_tofu_wait: {proto} key without a certificate check: the server didn’t answer — the exit doesn’t work yet
gw_exits.problem.key_unsupported: couldn’t read the {proto} key: xray won’t accept this kind (transport, security)
gw_exits.problem.key_weak_cipher: {proto} key without encryption or with a weak cipher — xray won’t accept it
gw_exits.problem.too_far: key beyond #{max} in the pool — the gateway doesn’t use it
gw_exits.problem.ru_too_far: Domestic key beyond #{max} — the gateway doesn’t use it
gw_exits.problem.unsupported_scheme: Kaskad doesn’t take such keys (it needs vless, hy2, ss, trojan, vmess, vpn:// or a .conf)
gw_exits.problem.vless_bad_pin: VLESS key: its certificate fingerprint (pcs) isn’t a SHA-256
gw_exits.problem.vless_insecure: VLESS key without a certificate check (allowInsecure): the certificate fingerprint couldn’t be taken — the exit doesn’t work; update the key or the subscription with pcs
gw_exits.problem.vless_tofu_wait: VLESS key without a certificate check (allowInsecure): the server didn’t answer during the update — the exit doesn’t work yet; Kaskad will try again by itself, at most once an hour (for up to 7 days)
gw_exits.problem.vless_unsupported: couldn’t read the VLESS key: xray won’t accept this kind (transport, security)
gw_exits.same_key: this key is already there as {id}, {how}
gw_exits.same_key_restored: (if it is another server restored from the same backup, it has the same keys — issue a new key there)
gw_exits.same_peer: Key {name} is added twice{also}: {how}. Only one will work — delete the extra one, the routes will move to the one that stays.
gw_exits.same_peer_n: Key {name} is added several times ({n}){also}: {how}. Only one will work — delete the extra ones, the routes will move to the one that stays.
gw_exits.same_peer_vless: Key {name} is added twice{also}: {how}. It is one VLESS account — both lines work, but the second one is extra: delete it, the routes will move to the one that stays.
gw_exits.same_peer_vless_n: Key {name} is added several times ({n}){also}: {how}. It is one VLESS account — all the lines work, but the extra ones are not needed: delete them, the routes will move to the one that stays.
gw_exits.state.alive_failing: working, but {why} (failed checks: {n} of {of} in 2 min)
gw_exits.state.alive_few: being checked: {why} (failed checks: {n} of {of}; decided from {min} checks)
gw_exits.state.clients_move: clients are moving to another exit
gw_exits.state.gw_off: turn on the gateway to check exits
gw_exits.state.no_data: no data: the collector (kaskad-gw-collect) isn’t sending reports, exits aren’t being checked
gw_exits.target.evict: exit {id} is unavailable — through the group “{group}”: exit {to}
gw_exits.target.none_alive: no live exits in the pool — {fall}
gw_exits.target.spread: “per connection”: the good exits of the active level
